metadata.timestampNote: Seconds on Unity realtime clock. RTMPose time is camera availability; baseline is callback delivery. guide_cue recordedAt is speech enqueue, not audible onset. Video is not encoded. REC time/frame aligns optional screen video.
metadata.imageCoordinates: Native model order. x is scaled by upright image aspect, y is up. Joint arrays are not reordered for avatar mirroring; arm features are. Halpe26 ROI uses normalized x-right/y-down.

caveat: Accepted observations only. Pre-session calibration state is unavailable. Cue schedules are not reviewed ground truth.

accuracyExclusions.reason: Do not judge left-knee extension performance from this run.

label: FULL BODY · STEP BACK
speech: Full body test, assistance off. Step back until your head, hands and feet are visible.

label: STARTING IN 3
speech: Three

label: STARTING IN 2
speech: Two

label: STARTING IN 1
speech: One

label: HOLD STILL · ARMS DOWN
speech: Stand upright with arms down. Hold still for six seconds.

label: ARMS FORWARD · HOLD · LOWER
speech: Extend both arms forward at shoulder height. Hold for two seconds, then lower. Repeat slowly.

label: ARMS OVERHEAD · HOLD · LOWER
speech: Raise both arms straight above your head. Hold for two seconds, then lower. Repeat.

label: ARMS TO THE SIDES · T POSE
speech: Extend both arms to the sides at shoulder height. Hold for two seconds, then lower. Repeat.

label: BEND AND STRAIGHTEN ELBOWS
speech: Bend both elbows to bring your hands up. Straighten forward, then sideways. Repeat slowly.

label: TORSO FORWARD BEND · RETURN
speech: Bend your torso forward comfortably, pause, then stand upright. Keep your feet still. Repeat slowly.

label: TORSO SIDE BENDS · LEFT / RIGHT
speech: Lean your torso left, return upright, then lean right. Keep both feet on the floor. Repeat.

label: TORSO TWIST · LEFT / RIGHT
speech: Turn your shoulders left and right while keeping your hips facing forward. Return to center each time.

label: HEAD TURN · LEFT / RIGHT
speech: Keep your body still. Turn your head left, then right, then look forward.

label: LEFT KNEE LIFT · HOLD · LOWER
speech: Lift your left knee comfortably. Hold for two seconds, then lower. Keep the other foot planted. Repeat.

label: RIGHT KNEE LIFT · HOLD · LOWER
speech: Lift your right knee comfortably. Hold for two seconds, then lower. Keep the other foot planted. Repeat.

label: LEFT LEG · GENTLE FRONT EXTENSION
speech: Lift your left knee, extend the foot gently forward, bend the knee again, then lower. Repeat slowly.

label: RIGHT LEG · GENTLE FRONT EXTENSION
speech: Lift your right knee, extend the foot gently forward, bend the knee again, then lower. Repeat slowly.

label: LEFT LEG · SIDE LIFT
speech: Lift your left leg gently to the side, pause, then return. Keep your torso upright. Repeat slowly.

label: RIGHT LEG · SIDE LIFT
speech: Lift your right leg gently to the side, pause, then return. Keep your torso upright. Repeat slowly.

label: SQUAT · HOLD · STAND
speech: Make a comfortable shallow squat. Hold for two seconds, then stand up. Repeat slowly.

label: HEEL RAISES · KEEP TOES DOWN
speech: Raise both heels while keeping your toes on the floor, then lower. Repeat slowly.

label: RETURN TO NEUTRAL · HOLD STILL
speech: Stand upright again with your arms down. Hold still so we can check recovery.

label: STEP OUT · RETURN · HOLD
speech: Step briefly out of the camera view, then return to the same standing position. Hold still.
